package rulefixtures

import "fmt"

// scenario for type_assertion_without_comma_ok: `v := i.(T)` without the comma-ok form in non-panic-safe code
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: warning.
func ExtractString(val interface{}) string {
	s := val.(string)
	return s
}

func ExtractInt(val interface{}) int {
	n := val.(int)
	return n
}

func ProcessMap(raw interface{}) []string {
	m := raw.(map[string]interface{})
	var keys []string
	for k := range m {
		keys = append(keys, k)
	}
	return keys
}

func DescribeShape(v interface{}) string {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case string:
		s := v.(string)
		return fmt.Sprintf("string(%s)", s)
	case int:
		i := v.(int)
		return fmt.Sprintf("int(%d)", i)
	default:
		_ = x
		return "unknown"
	}
}
